name: Louisiana

laws.cite: LAC 4:V, Chapter 61 (PPM No. 74, Web Accessibility Compliance), under R.S. 39:8
laws.summary: Division of Administration memorandum requiring every executive branch agency to name a web accessibility coordinator, adopt an agency web accessibility policy at WCAG 2.1 AA minimum, post an accessibility statement, and report progress on a fixed schedule.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: PPM 74 as originally issued 2025-02-10 (WCAG 2.2 AA; agency-hosted copy)
OTS Guide to Accessible Web Services

applies_to: All boards, commissions, departments, agencies, institutions and offices of the executive branch. Local governments are not covered by PPM 74 (ADA Title II only).

deadlines.what: PPM 74: inventory of major web properties
PPM 74: submit agency Web Accessibility Policy
PPM 74: non-exempt web content compliant (date set before the DOJ extension; PPM not verified as updated)
ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: At least one full-time employee designated as web accessibility coordinator; training within 90 days
Agency Web Accessibility Policy adopting WCAG 2.1 AA at minimum
Accessibility statement linked from agency home page with coordinator name, email and phone
Internal controls (pre-publication screening, fewer authors, vendor remediation)
Inventory, action plan and status reporting to the State ADA Coordinator
mobile: explicit — PPM 74 defines mobile applications and covers agency websites and mobile apps.
procurement: Not specified in PPM 74; OTS says it is improving procurement processes. No statewide VPAT/ACR mandate verified.
enforcement: Administrative: filings go to the Office of State ADA Coordinator; OTS gives technical support. No private right of action beyond ADA Title II.
notes: Original PPM 74 (LR 51:327, Feb 2025) required WCAG 2.2 AA; amendment LR 51:765 effective 2025-06-09 lowered the minimum to WCAG 2.1 AA. The 2025 amendment PDF URL surfaced in search (ppm-74-amendment...) returned 404; the r6-25 consolidated text was used. PPM's 2026-04-24 compliance date predates the DOJ extension.
